mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone may increase bupropion metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing bupropion efficacy, while bupropion may inhibit progesterone metabolism affecting contraceptive reliability.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy and consider bupropion dose adjustment; counsel on backup contraception methods as bupropion may reduce medroxyprogesterone contraceptive effectiveness.
